info.name: StyleMind Stylist — Wave 2 Generation and Recommendations
info.description: Gateway collection for P03-B1 intake, Wave 2 generation, owner-scoped recommendation reads, and negative checks. Requires real local services and approved runtime catalog/provider configuration for a successful generation. No token or secret is embedded.

exec: pm.test('session created', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(201); });
pm.test('session id stored', function () { var b = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(b.session_id).to.be.a('string'); pm.environment.set('sessionId', b.session_id); });

item.name: 2. Intake request as Customer A (must remain RECEIVED)

body.raw:
{
  "message": "Tôi cần một bộ đi làm gọn gàng, màu trung tính.",
  "occasion": "đi làm",
  "style_context": "tối giản",
  "max_budget_vnd": 850000,
  "budget_is_hard": true,
  "constraints": []
}

exec: pm.test('intake stores only', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(201); var b = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(b.request_status).to.eql('RECEIVED'); pm.expect(b.generation_started).to.eql(false); pm.environment.set('requestId', b.request_id); });
pm.test('no-store', function () { pm.expect(pm.response.headers.get('Cache-Control')).to.include('no-store'); });

pm.test('generation returned a terminal success/no-result response', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(200); var b = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(['SUCCEEDED','NO_RESULT']).to.include(b.request_status); pm.expect(b).to.have.property('limitations'); if (b.request_status === 'SUCCEEDED') { pm.expect(b.recommendations.length).to.be.within(1,3); pm.environment.set('recommendationId', b.recommendations[0].recommendation_id); } else { pm.expect(b.recommendations).to.eql([]); } });
pm.test('no-store', function () { pm.expect(pm.response.headers.get('Cache-Control')).to.include('no-store'); });

pm.test('owner can read persisted status', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(200); var b = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(b.request_id).to.eql(pm.environment.get('requestId')); pm.expect(['SUCCEEDED','NO_RESULT','FAILED','PROCESSING','RECEIVED']).to.include(b.request_status); pm.expect(b.recommendations).to.be.an('array'); });
pm.test('no-store', function () { pm.expect(pm.response.headers.get('Cache-Control')).to.include('no-store'); });

pm.test('detail shows stored explanation and current Commerce semantics', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(200); var b = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(b.recommendation_id).to.eql(pm.environment.get('recommendationId')); pm.expect(b.price_semantics).to.eql('CURRENT_COMMERCE_DATA_NOT_HISTORICAL'); pm.expect(b.items).to.have.length(2); pm.expect(b.items.map(function (i) { return i.slot_name; })).to.eql(['TOP','BOTTOM']); });
pm.test('no-store', function () { pm.expect(pm.response.headers.get('Cache-Control')).to.include('no-store'); });

item.name: 6. Customer B cannot read Customer A request

exec: pm.test('foreign request is concealed as 404', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(404); pm.expect(pm.response.json().code).to.eql('RESOURCE_NOT_FOUND'); });
pm.test('no-store', function () { pm.expect(pm.response.headers.get('Cache-Control')).to.include('no-store'); });
pm.test('unknown generation input is rejected before provider work', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(400); pm.expect(pm.response.json().code).to.eql('INVALID_REQUEST'); });
pm.test('no-store', function () { pm.expect(pm.response.headers.get('Cache-Control')).to.include('no-store'); });

item.name: 8. Replay terminal generation without another model call

exec: pm.test('terminal response replays stored result', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(200); var b = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(['SUCCEEDED','NO_RESULT']).to.include(b.request_status); });
pm.test('no-store', function () { pm.expect(pm.response.headers.get('Cache-Control')).to.include('no-store'); });

item.name: 9. Intake 2,000 Vietnamese code points for token-budget regression

exec: pm.test('the documented Unicode code-point limit is accepted at intake', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(201); var b = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(b.request_status).to.eql('RECEIVED'); pm.expect(b.generation_started).to.eql(false); pm.environment.set('budgetRequestId', b.request_id); });
pm.test('no-store', function () { pm.expect(pm.response.headers.get('Cache-Control')).to.include('no-store'); });

item.name: 10. Reject over-budget assembled input before chat generation

exec: pm.test('provider token preflight returns bounded input error', function () { pm.response.to.have.status(413); pm.expect(pm.response.json().code).to.eql('GENERATION_INPUT_TOO_LARGE'); });
pm.test('no-store', function () { pm.expect(pm.response.headers.get('Cache-Control')).to.include('no-store'); });
